form.title: Clean Vehicle Credit Amount
form.notes: refundable: false. One of these is filed PER VEHICLE — 'Complete a separate Schedule A (Form 8936) for each clean vehicle placed in service during the tax year' — and it is where every clean vehicle figure is actually computed; Form 8936 only totals them. Declared here because Schedule 2 lines 1b and 1c name it outright as the source of a repayment, and a route may not leave from a Part. THE TERMINATION DATE IS ON THIS FORM'S OWN FACE, which is better evidence than the instructions: line 5 asks whether the VIN 'belong[s] to a new clean vehicle acquired before October 1, 2025', line 6 'a previously owned clean vehicle acquired after 2022 and before October 1, 2025', line 7 'a qualified commercial clean vehicle acquired after 2022 and before October 1, 2025'. 2025 figures read off this schedule: previously owned credit is 30% of sales price capped at $4,000 (lines 15, 16) with the vehicle's sales price capped at $25,000 (line 13e); commercial credit is 15% of basis net of section 179, or 30% if not also gas or diesel powered, capped at the incremental cost and at $7,500 — '$40,000 if the vehicle's gross vehicle weight rating (see line 18e) is 14,000 pounds or more' (lines 22, 24, 25). Printed revision: Schedule A (Form 8936) 2025, Created 8/21/25.
